title: Workstream C: AU-RCC Fleet Classification Reconciliation

classification_schema_definitions.STATISTICALLY_SUPERIOR: Confidence AU-RCC is lower than random baseline (Delta AU-RCC < 0) AND at least one coverage tier rejects H0 under Holm-Bonferroni correction at alpha = 0.05 with adequate sample support.
classification_schema_definitions.LOWER_AURCC_OBSERVED: Confidence AU-RCC is numerically lower than random baseline (Delta AU-RCC < 0), but zero coverage tiers achieve statistical significance under Holm-Bonferroni correction.
classification_schema_definitions.RANDOM_BASELINE_SUPERIOR: Random baseline AU-RCC is lower than confidence AU-RCC (Delta AU-RCC > 0), confirming selection pathology under unweighted Policy A.
classification_schema_definitions.NO_SIGNIFICANT_DIFFERENCE: Delta AU-RCC is approximately 0.0 and no coverage tiers reject the null hypothesis in either direction.
classification_schema_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_CLASS_SUPPORT: Population size or minority class count is inadequate to support statistically reliable inference (e.g. truncated history in XMR).
